mechanics.name: Eternal Conviction
mechanics.should_have_been: Tanks take about 64k and usually live. Healers and DPS take about 97k of the same cast. The stack size does not change the hit.

mechanics.name: Sacred Sever
mechanics.should_have_been: A full share of 4 that people live is about 35–63k. A stack of 1 or 2 is larger, and still this mechanic if it stays under the role cap. Cleaves are a different hit.

mechanics.name: Hiemal Storm
mechanics.should_have_been: A placed ice hit is about 25–40k. This does not split like a stack.

mechanics.name: Holy Impact
mechanics.should_have_been: Same shape as Eternal Conviction. Tanks take about 63k. Everyone else takes about 95–103k, even in a full party of 8.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Rage
mechanics.should_have_been: The three non-tanks without the blue marker stack under Thordan. A lived share is about 60–80k, usually 5 people, those three plus both tanks. Whether the tanks are supposed to share it is not known, so 5 stays the full share. A stack of 3 around 102–113k is that share with two bodies missing.

mechanics.name: Skyward Leap
mechanics.should_have_been: The blue marker on three non-tanks. Opposite Thordan is as far away as possible. East and west are slightly toward the north, not too far. A real leap is 59–70k. Dying to it is a healer mistake when they were not full, a mitigation mistake when they were full and the mit was missing, or a clip when someone was out of that spot. A soaked tower does not deal this. The three towers that are not on those markers are not fixed, so two people in one of them is a miscommunication. An empty tower explodes for about 600–760k and applies Damage Down and Paralysis to everyone.

mechanics.name: Heavenly Heel
mechanics.should_have_been: The off tank takes Heavenly Heel. They provoke so they have aggro when it locks. The main tank takes the three-hit Ascalon's Might. A lived heel is about 159–174k before mit, with Rampart and Sheltron. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit is their mistake. If the main tank dies because the off tank did not have aggro when it locked, that death is the off tank's. An off tank who dies to the real heel without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Holy Bladedance
mechanics.should_have_been: The cone after each tether. That tank takes several hits around 20–22k with personal mitigation. Anyone else in the cone owns that hit. A tank who dies on the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Lightning Storm
mechanics.should_have_been: Each safe triangle is healer in front, melee left, ranged right, tank in back. One hit each: tanks about 26–29k, everyone else about 38–45k. Two of the same non-tank role on one side, a player out of that spot, or two players clipping are mistakes. A clip is about 430–470k, and both players own it.

mechanics.name: Bright Flare
mechanics.should_have_been: A single orb is about 64k. Overlaps sit above the role cap.

mechanics.name: Ascalon's Might
mechanics.should_have_been: One tank takes the three hits, about 71–86k each. When the warrior takes it, he invulns it or heavy-mits it. The later three-hit is the main tank's, after the off tank takes Heavenly Heel. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit is their mistake. A tank who dies to the real hits without personal mitigation owns that death.

mechanics.name: Ascalon's Mercy Concealed
mechanics.should_have_been: The opener is one tank in front and everyone else stacked behind, then a dodge. During Strength of the Ward the party is walking toward the middle while dodging Heavy Impact, so that cast is a 4/4 split. The front-and-back stack does not apply there. Nobody is hit either time. On the opener, a cone baited from outside the stack is also the baiter's mistake.

mechanics.name: Heavy Impact
mechanics.should_have_been: The knight's pulses, outward. A hit stuns and applies Damage Down. Clean pulls take 0. Both ability ids are this ring.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Glory
mechanics.should_have_been: A successful gaze is 0.

mechanics.name: Dragon's Gaze
mechanics.should_have_been: A successful gaze is 0.

mechanics.name: Holy Shield Bash
mechanics.should_have_been: Each tank takes one tether. The hit stuns. A non-tank who takes that stun dies. Stretch the tether and use personal mitigation. A short tether is the failed bash: hundreds of thousands to millions.

mechanics.name: Shining Blade
mechanics.should_have_been: Hits that kill are the failed cleave.

mechanics.name: Heavens' Stake
mechanics.should_have_been: Hits that kill are standing in the fire.

mechanics.name: Frostbite
mechanics.should_have_been: Frostbite is the failed ice soak.

mechanics.name: Dimensional Collapse
mechanics.should_have_been: Puddles on the floor during the second wave. A hit applies Heavy and Damage Down. Any hit is a mistake. No lived band is stored.

clusters.name: Ascalon's Mercy Concealed
clusters.summary: About 14 seconds. One tank stands in front of the boss. Everyone else stacks tight behind it, then dodges together. Nobody is hit. The cones come back inside Strength of the Ward as a 4/4 split.

clusters.name: Ascalon's Might
clusters.summary: The opener tankbuster, about 17 seconds in. Three hits on one tank. When the warrior takes it, he invulns it or heavy-mits it. The same three-hit comes back with Heavenly Heel as the tank swap.

clusters.name: Strength of the Ward
clusters.summary: About 43 to 65 seconds. Three knights dash and leave two safe triangles. Each triangle spreads Lightning Storm: healer in front, melee left, ranged right, tank in back. Heavy Impact then pulses outward. The party walks toward the middle, and Thordan's Ascalon's Mercy Concealed is a 4/4 split. On the second pulse the knights drop. Tanks take the two tethers. The tether stuns, and a non-tank who takes it dies. Three non-tanks take Skyward Leap: opposite Thordan as far as possible, east and west slightly toward the north. The other three stack under him. A leap death is a healer, a missing mitigation, or a clip. Floor puddles go out with that. Six towers follow. The three that are not on the Skyward Leap markers are not fixed, and two people in one of them is a miscommunication. A soaked tower deals little. An empty one explodes. Eternal Conviction still hits as this ends.

clusters.name: Heavenly Heel
clusters.summary: The tank swap, about 81 seconds. The off tank provokes and takes Heavenly Heel. The main tank takes the three-hit Ascalon's Might. If the main tank dies to the heel because the off tank did not have aggro when it locked, that death is the off tank's. Anyone who is not a tank getting hit owns that mistake. An off tank who dies on the real heel without personal mitigation owns that death.

clusters.name: Sanctity of the Ward
clusters.summary: About 112 seconds. Look away from Dragon's Gaze and Dragon's Glory. Sacred Sever is the shared jump between the sword markers while the knights dash. Shining Blade is a failed dash. Bright Flare is a failed orb.

clusters.name: Meteors
clusters.summary: The second half of Sanctity, about 130 seconds. Pairs drop Hiemal Storm. Frostbite is a failed ice. Heavens' Stake is the fire, not the meteor. Holy Comet is the meteor drop and has not killed anyone in this log. Eternal Conviction and Holy Impact are the heavy hits that follow.
